purpose: Complete index of every evidence artifact in this directory tree, with SHA-256 hashes and classification tags, so an independent auditor (Agent B) can verify file integrity and provenance without access to this project's conversation history.

classification_taxonomy.EXECUTED: A command/test/benchmark was actually run and its real output is what's recorded.
classification_taxonomy.MEASURED: A quantitative result (recall, latency, storage bytes, counts) came from an actual execution, not an estimate.
classification_taxonomy.OFFICIAL_VENDOR_FACT: Sourced from a vendor's own current official documentation, ideally with a verbatim quote and URL.
classification_taxonomy.DERIVED: A conclusion computed/reasoned from other recorded EXECUTED/MEASURED/OFFICIAL_VENDOR_FACT evidence.
classification_taxonomy.INFERENCE: A reasonable but not directly-verified judgment call, labeled as such.
classification_taxonomy.NOT_EXECUTED: Explicitly not run/verified - a gap, honestly labeled rather than hidden or implied.
classification_taxonomy.EVIDENCE_LOST: Known from prior conversation context but the original supporting artifact no longer exists; not re-fabricated to look pristine.
